column3: “kinsman” renders “relative”; “a man of great wealth” renders “a man mighty of wealth,” and “family” renders “clan” (also in verse 3).
“she happened to come to” renders “her chance chanced upon.”
The end of this verse is difficult in Hebrew; NASB’s “she has been sitting in the house for a little while” is one reading.
“Listen carefully” renders the question “Have you not heard?”; “maids” renders “female servants.”
“Indeed, I have commanded” renders the question “Have I not commanded?”; “servants” renders “young men.”
“take notice of me” renders “pay regard to me.”
“fully reported” renders the doubled verb; “previously” renders “yesterday and three days ago.”
“I have found” renders “May I find” or “I am finding”; “spoken kindly to” renders “spoken to the heart of.”
“bread” renders “food”; NASB supplies “of bread,” and “served” renders “held out.”
“Naomi” renders “her”; “after she was satisfied” renders “from her abundance.”
“kindness” renders “covenant loyalty (hesed)”; “one of our closest relatives” renders “one of our kinsman-redeemers.”
